queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Bdash %' AND publisher = 'Kazuhito Hokamura';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Bdash %' AND publisher = 'Kazuhito Hokamura' AND version_compare(version, '1.35.1') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'bdash.exe');
